original: tathāca yadyapi smoraṇalakṣaṇaikapratītivartināṃ na viśeṣastatathāpi yaugapādyaviparītakramābhivyamaktyapekṣayā kramoccāritānāmasyek va viśeṣa ityaśata āha-nityāānāmiti| varṇānāṃ nityvibhūnāṃ kālato deśataśca na vāstavavaḥ kramo niyāmakaḥ, sattāmātreṇa tadaṅgīkāre'tiprasaṅga iti pratipattayūpādhiko'yamaṅgīkāryaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca yadi api smoraṇa lakṣaṇa eka pratīti vartinām na viśeṣaḥ tatathā api yaugapādya viparīta krama abhivyamakti apekṣayā viśeṣaḥ iti aśataḥ āha nitya iti varṇānām nitya vibhūnām kālataḥ deśataḥ ca na kramaḥ niyāmakaḥ sattā mātreṇa tad aṅgīkāra iti prasaṅgaḥ iti pratipattayā upādhikaḥ ayam aṅgīkāryaḥ

original: sā cedekā smṛtirūpā kutasatarhi krama ityekasmṛnatyuṇapārūḍhānāṃ varṇānāṃ kramākramaviparītakramābhivyāṅgyānāṃ na kaścidviśeṣa iti||7||

original: nānubhūtikramādvarṇāḥ kramikāḥ smṛtigocarāḥ| gocaro'nubhavo nāsyāṇastatatkrmastu kutastatarām||8||

original: nanu pūrvapūrvavarṇānubhavāḥ kramavanta‍sttkrasamatayā varṇeṣva8pyemakasmṛvatisamārohiṣvauāpādhikaḥ kramaḥ svīkakāryaḥ| tathācāhurmīmāṃsāvārtikakāramiśrāḥ - padāvadhāraṇopāyānbavahūnicchamanti sūrayaḥ| kramanyūonātiriktatvsvacharavākyataśrutismṛtatīḥ|| iti| na kevalamekārthapratyāya evaikaṃ padamiti vyūpadeśanimittam, kiṃtu kramādayo'pītyerthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu pūrva pūrva varṇa anubhavāḥ kramavantaḥ varṇeṣu kramaḥ svīkakāryaḥ tathā ca āhuḥ mīmāṃsā vārtika kāra miśrāḥ sūrayaḥ iti na kevalam eka artha pratyāyaḥ eva ekam padam iti kiṃtu krama ādayaḥ api iti erthaḥ

original: tatra rasaḥ sara ityadatra kramaḥ| karaḥ karañja ityatatra nyūtanātiriktatvema| inadraśatrurityatatra sveraḥ| sā raṅgamāgatā nartakīti vākyavam| parame vyotamanniti śrutiḥ| gṛbhṇāmamīti ‘hṛgṛhorbhaśchandūsi' iti pāṇinismṛyatiḥ| tathāca pūrvānubhavakrama ekasmṛgatau viśeṣakaḥ|
analyzed: tatra rasaḥ saraḥ iti at atra kramaḥ karaḥ karañjaḥ iti atatra sveraḥ sā raṅgam āgatā nartakī iti parame iti pāṇini smṛyatiḥ tathā ca pūrva anubhava kramaḥ eka smṛ gatau viśeṣakaḥ

original: tathācāhurnyāāyaṭīkākāramiśrā api- ‘arthapratyyakāraṇatvaṃsa ca na varṇamātrāṇāmapi tu kramanyūnātiriktatvāaudyupahitānām' ityayata āha- nānubhūtīti|
analyzed: tathā ca āhuḥ nyāāya ṭīkākāra miśrāḥ api artha pratyya kāraṇa tvam sa ca na varṇa mātrāṇām api tu iti ayatas āha na anubhūti iti

original: iyaṃ pūrvapūrvavarṇānubhavajanyāa tāvadvarṇaviṣayiṇyevakā smṛṇatiḥ pūrvavarṇānubhavānena na gocarayati kutasteāṣāṃ kramam? evaṃ ca prācīnānubhavopādhiko'pi kramaḥ smataryamāṇeṣu varṇeṣu na viśeṣaka iti na tāvadvarṇasamūhāvalambunasmṛnatyāparthapratyatayopapatteranyuthopapattiriti||8||
analyzed: iyam pūrva pūrva varṇa anubhava janyā tāvat varṇa viṣayiṇī evakā smṛṇatiḥ pūrva varṇa anubhavānena na gocarayati kutas teāṣām kramam evam ca prācīna anubhava upādhikaḥ api kramaḥ varṇeṣu na viśeṣakaḥ iti na tāvat varṇa samūha avalambuna smṛnatyā apartha pratyatayā upapatteḥ anyuthā upapattiḥ iti

original: idaṃ padamidaṃ vākyamidaṃ varṇā iti triṣu| pratyamayeṣu sphuiṭaṃ sphoṛṭa eka evānubhūyate||9||
analyzed: idam padam idam vākyam idam varṇāḥ iti triṣu pratyamayeṣu sphuiṭam sphoṛṭaḥ ekaḥ eva anubhūyate

original: nanu prābhākaramate'nubhavāḥ svaṃprakāśā iti tatkratamaḥ smṛ‍tau bhāsate| satyaṃda, nahi jñānaṃ svataprakāśamiti tatkraṣamo'pi sva prakāśaḥ, tasyāṛ'svatarūpatvākadaviṣayatvāṛcca| atha sverūpaviṣayātirikta ātmāṃśaḥ sphukaratīti cet, tānevaitatpṛracchama ye tadaṅgīkurvate na vayaṃ tripuṭīpratyavakṣavādinaḥ|
analyzed: nanu prābhākara mata inubhavāḥ svaṃprakāśāḥ iti smṛtau bhāsate nahi jñānam svata prakāśam iti sva prakāśaḥ atha ye tat aṅgīkurvate na vayam tripuṭī pratyavakṣa vādinaḥ

original: na ca tairapi jñānakramaḥ sveprakāśa iti svīvakriyata iti| nanu kāryānusāriṇī kāraṇakalparanā, tathācājñāto'pi vastuḥtaḥ sthitaḥ kramo viśeṣako vaktavy iti gāmānayeti dṛśya mānebhya eva varṇebhyaraścedabhidheyapratyathayaḥ upapadyate tadā naitānapahāyādṛśyṛmānamanavayavakaṃ sphoyaṭatattvaṃna kalpānīyaṃ pramāṇābhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca taiḥ api jñāna kramaḥ sveprakāśaḥ iti iti nanu kārya anusāriṇī tathā ca ajñātaḥ api vastuḥ atas sthitaḥ kramaḥ viśeṣakaḥ vaktavī iti gām ānaya iti dṛśya mānebhyaḥ eva upapadyate tadā na etān apahāya adṛśyṛ mānam anavayavakam sphoyaṭa tattvam na kalpānīyam pramāṇa abhāvāt

original: yā cārthapratipattisttpratamāṇatve noktā sā'nyotanyādaśrayagrastāna| tathāhi arthapratipattau satyāṃka tadanupapattyāra spho ṭapratipattiḥ, sphauthaapratipattau cārthapratipattiritya ta āha- idamiti| na kalpyāmyhaṃ sphotaṭaṃ, pratyapakṣameva tveranamavagacchārami|
analyzed: yā ca artha pratipattiḥ na uktā tathā hi artha pratipattau tad anupapattyā tathā hi tat āha idam iti na tat eva

original: tathāhi gauritye‍kaṃ padaṃ gāmānayetyāpadyekaṃ vākyatamiti sarvajanasiddho'yamanubhavo nāpahnavanīyaḥ| tatra pūrvapūrvavarṇagrahaṇāhitasaṃskānarāyāmanusaṃhārabuddhāvavaśyasamabhinnaṃ vasve'ya kaṃ samullasatītyeśaṇīyam| na khalviyamabhinnavastutanirbhāsābuddhiḥ paraspasaravytiricyatamānātma no varṇāneva gocarayitumarhati|
analyzed: tathā hi gauḥ iti ekam padam gām ānaya iti āpadi ekam vākyatam iti sarva jana siddhaḥ ayam anubhavaḥ na apahnavanīyaḥ tatra pūrva pūrva varṇa grahaṇa āhita saṃskānarāyām anusaṃhāra buddhau avaśya sama bhinnam samullasati iti eśaṇīyam na khalu iyam abhinna vastuta nirbhāsā buddhiḥ naḥ varṇān eva gocarayitum arhati

original: etādṛśabuddhiviṣaye vastupanyesakasimannekatvabanānātvadayorasamavāyāt| na ca vanamiti buddhervṛkṣā iva padamitivākyomitibuddhervaṇā eva viṣayā bhavantīiti vācyapam| tatraikadeśasyenavātraikabuddhiviṣayatvayasyai kārthapratyāṛyakatvāidervopādherananusaṃdhānāt| atra padasphovaṭavādino'pi matasamarthanāya padamitibuddherityuektam|
analyzed: etādṛśa buddhi viṣaye asamavāyāt na ca vanam iti buddheḥ vṛkṣāḥ iva padam iti vākya ūm iti buddheḥ vaṇāḥ eva viṣayāḥ bhavanti iti

original: vastudatasvra navayavaḥ sphoyaṭa eva vākyārthavācaka iti mukhyapasphooṭavādino matam| tatra cedaṃ tattvaṃna-kadācidvākyayamiti kadācidiyanti padānīti kadācidetāvanto varṇā iti buddhirūdeti| tatrādye tāvadekabuddherekatvādavagāhinyāya ekameva kiṃcidvastui pratīyamānaṃ kāraṇamityu‍papāditam| anyaṃdeta dvayamavaśiṣyavate|
analyzed: navayavaḥ sphoyaṭaḥ eva vākya artha vācakaḥ iti mukhya pasphooṭa vādinaḥ matam tatra ca idam tattvam na kadācid vākī ayam iti kadācid iyanti padāni iti kadācid etāvantaḥ varṇāḥ iti buddhiḥ ūdeti tatra ādye tāvat eka buddheḥ eka tvāt avagāhinyāye ekam eva kiṃcid pratīyamānam kāraṇam iti upapāditam dvayam avaśiṣyavate

original: tatra yadi dedatta gāmānayeti tribhiḥ padaiḥ pāramārthikaviśiṣṭapaurvāparyairārabdhaṃi vākyaṃu syārattadā ānaya gāṃ devadattetyuyakte tasyā vayavino bhaṅgāttajjanyāirthapratīlilakṣaṇā'rthakriyā na syāmat, dhvaisteṃṣu kapāleśūdakāharaṇādivat|

original: tathā yadi devadatta gāmānayetayatra pāramārthakāḥ kramaviśeṣaviśiṣṭā aṣṭau varṇā vākyāyaramabhakāḥ syuestakadā gāṃ devadattānayetyadatra saptavarṇā‍ bhinnakramāśceti tato nārthapratyanayaḥ syāāt|

original: tasmāādvarṇapadavibhāgamāvidyakamaṅgīkṛtyaka sarveṣūccāryamāṇeṣvanusyūyataḥ kaścidarthapratyatayayaupayiko vākyātmā'navayavo nityayaḥ spho‍ṭo'ṅgīkartavy iti ||9||
analyzed: sarveṣu uccāryamāṇeṣu anusyūyataḥ kaścid artha pratyataya yayaupayikaḥ vākya ātmā anavayavaḥ sphoṭaḥ aṅgīkartavī iti

original: dṛṣṭā hi tadātma ni taduparāgavatī buddhirvane vṛkṣā iti, tatsatamavāyini paṭe tanta‍va iti| naitadubhayaṃ prakṛte'syetenaṅgīkārāditaya āha nityāha iti| iha nityeā sphovaṭe nityā| vibhavaśca varṇā nāvayavā ucitāḥ| avayavin‍yūnapariṇamatvā'davayavānām| nāpyaṅanityāāstithā, avayavino nityaphasyānavayavāsaṃbhavāt|
analyzed: dṛṣṭā hi tad uparāgavatī buddhiḥ vane vṛkṣāḥ iti tad satama vāyini paṭe tantavaḥ iti na etat ubhayam āha nitya aha iti iha nityāḥ vibhavaḥ ca varṇāḥ na avayavāḥ ucitāḥ avayavi nyūna pariṇama tvāt avayavānām na api avayavinaḥ anavayava asaṃbhavāt

original: ataḥ kevalaṃ tasyaca sphoāṭasyi vivartāḥ| evaṃ ca pramārūpāvarṇoparāgavatī dhīrmābhūt bhrāntirūpā tvathasyetya va| naca vastuyatastādrūpeṇa tatsemavāyitayā vā taduparaktabuddhiriti niyamaḥ| śukterapi rajatoparaktabuddhiviṣayatvāīt|
analyzed: atas kevalam vivartāḥ evam ca pramā rūpā a varṇa uparāgavatī dhīḥ mā bhūt bhrānti rūpā na ca vastu yatas tādrūpeṇa tad semavāyi tayā vā tad uparakta buddhiḥ iti niyamaḥ śukteḥ api rajata uparakta buddhi viṣaya tvāt

original: tasmātadvivartādhiṣṭhānasyava paramārthasataḥ sphoraṭarūpasyāmavidyākalpitena varṇavivartena tattaduparāgavatī prakhyā na virudhyavate| naca varṇānāṃ kcidapyasabhāvānna vivarta iti vācyakam| kvāpya‍satāṃ ghaṭādiprapañcānāmiva brahmajhayavabhāsopapatteritya nyutra visatara ityāṃha-prapañcā iti||10||
analyzed: paramārtha sataḥ paramārtha sataḥ sphoraṭa rūpasyām avidyā kalpitena varṇa vivartena tat tat uparāgavatī prakhyā na na na ca varṇānām kcid api a sabhāvāt na vivartaḥ iti vācyakam kvāpi asatām ghaṭa ādi prapañcānām iva iti āṃha prapañcāḥ iti

original: prathamāntatapadasamabhivyādaharājñānādeva dhāvanakartṛmṛgakarmakadarśanānvarayabodho bhavati na tu tadvibhaktivyaṃtirekata iti prathamāpi na syāmaditi niryuktikamata āha-kiṃ ceti| tacca ekavākytvaṃe ca anupapannameveti dhāvanakartṛmṛgakarmakadarśānāśrayasv na miti bodhasvīkāre phaṇivivakṣitaikavākyadatvācanupapattiriti bhāvaḥ|

original: nanu mṛgakartṛkotkeṭadhāvanasyā dṛśikriyāyāmanva yaḥ phaṇitātpaḥryaviṣaya ityeva kuto'vagamyarata ityātaśaṅkya "vyārakhyāvanato viśeṣapratipattirnahi saṃdehādalakṣaṇam' ityābhiprāyeṇa bhāṣyāerthaspa'ṣṭītakartṛhelārājasaṃmatimāha-phalisaṃmatistviti|

original: tena mṛga iti subantaṃra darśane viśeṣaṇaṃ na, mṛgakartṛkotkabhaṭadhāvanaṃ darśane viśeṣaṇamiti helārājena spasaṣṭīkaraṇena| evakārottaraṃ ‘karmatayā dṛśikriyāyāmanvyasyṛ' iti śeṣaḥ| vivakṣāyāmityajanantīraṃ ‘prayuktasyaña paśyata mṛgo dhāvati iti vākyaṭasyara' iti śeṣaḥ| na pratīkāraḥ na nirākaraṇam|
analyzed: tena mṛgaḥ iti darśane viśeṣaṇam na mṛga kartṛka utkabhaṭa dhāvanam darśane viśeṣaṇam iti helārājena eva kāra uttaram karmatayā iti śeṣaḥ vivakṣāyām paśyata mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti śeṣaḥ na pratīkāraḥ na nirākaraṇam

original: tathā ca tādṛśamṛgasy karmatayā tatrānvakayasvī|kāre phalisaṃmatavākayatvāṭanupapattireva doṣa iti bhāvaḥ| nanu ‘prakṛtipratya yau sahārthaṃ brūtasta yoḥ pratyatayārthasyaya prādhānyapham' iti niyamāddhātvrthaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣya tāsaṃbandheranānvakayabuddhiṃ prati viśeṣyaśatayā pratyarayajanyopasthitirheturiti kāryakāraṇabhāvena darśane
analyzed: tathā ca karmatayā tatra anvakaya svīkāre phali saṃmata vākayatvāt anupapattiḥ eva doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu prakṛti pratya yau saha artham brūtaḥ tayoḥ iti niyamāt dhātu rtha niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita viśeṣya tā saṃbandheḥ an anvakaya buddhim prati pratyaraya janya upasthitiḥ hetuḥ iti kārya kāraṇa bhāvena darśane

original: pratyaṭhayajanyotapasthiterabhāvena dhāvanasyaka tatrānvauyo na saṃbhavatīti mṛgasyaiova tatrānvyena tārkikapakṣa eva samīcīna iti cenna, niruktaniyamādeva prakṛtyrthaprakārakabodhe viśeṣyatatayā pratyaṃyajanyosapasthiteḥ kāraṇatvena karmatvoipasthitya rthaṃ dvitīyāpekṣā| tathā ca paśy mṛgo dhāvatīti vākayocche‍dāpatte rityāāha-anya‍theti|
analyzed: abhāvena na saṃbhavati iti tatra anvauyaḥ na saṃbhavati iti tatra anvyena tārkika pakṣaḥ eva samīcīnaḥ iti ced na nirukta niyamāt eva prakṛti ṛtha prakāraka bodhe kāraṇa tvena dvitīyā apekṣā tathā ca paśi mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti vākayā uccheda āpatteḥ iti āha anyathā iti

original: karmatvotapasthityararthaṃ dvitīyāsvīkakāre iti tadarthaḥ| tathā ca subanta|sthla eva tādṛśanyāvaśrayaścaritārthastiṅantatastha‍le dhātvanarthaviśeṣyakakānvapayabodha eva svī karaṇīya iti laḍarthavivakṣāyāmapi bhūtabhaviṣyayadvartamānaviṣayakajñāne vartamānakālikatvānvasayasaṃbhavena kriyāvinirmuktaṃ vākayasaṃgatamityāāha-kiṃ ceti|

original: prathamāntāṣarthamukhyayaviśeṣyarakabodhasvī kāre doṣāntataramāha-kiṃ ceti| ‘śṛṇu garjati meghaḥ' ityakatra garjanāśrayameghakarmakaśravaṇāśrayasveṣmiti naiyāyikamate bodhaḥ| sa ca na saṃbhavati śabdisyaiṛva śrāvyanatvetana medhasyāśrayāvyakatvātat| meghābhinnaikāśrayavṛttigarjanakarmakaśravaṇaṃ tvatadabhinnaikāśrayakamiti vaiyākaraṇamate bodhaḥ|
analyzed: bodha svī kāre doṣa antataram āha kim ca iti śṛṇu garjati meghaḥ iti naiyāyika mate bodhaḥ sa ca na saṃbhavati megha abhinna eka āśraya vṛtti garjana karmaka śravaṇam tu a tad abhinna eka āśrayakam iti vaiyākaraṇa mate bodhaḥ

original: sa ca samīcīna eva| ‘naṭo gāyati śṛṇu' ityabhatra gānāśrayanaṭakarmakaśravaṇāśrayasvaṃvi iti tārkikamate bodhaḥ| sa ca na saṃbhavati naṭasyāāśrāvya tvātat| naṭābhinnaikāśrayavṛttigānakarmakaśravaṇaṃ tvdabhinnaikāśrayakamiti vaiyākaraṇakate bodhaḥ| sa ca yathārtha eva|
analyzed: sa ca samīcīnaḥ eva naṭaḥ gāyati śṛṇu iti gāna āśraya naṭa karmaka śravaṇa āśraya svaṃvi iti tārkika mate bodhaḥ sa ca na saṃbhavati naṭasya ā āśrāvya naṭa abhinna eka āśraya vṛtti gāna karmaka śravaṇam vaiyākaraṇa kate bodhaḥ sa ca yathārthaḥ eva

original: ‘ghaṭo'naśya‍tpayaśyapa' ityitra cātītotpttikanāśapratiyogikaghaṭakarmakadarśanāśrayastvaramiti nyā|yamate bodhaḥ| sa ca na saṃbhavati ghaṭasyaśa naṣṭatvenana taddarśanāsaṃbhavāt| ghaṭābhinnaikapratiyogikātītotpayattikanāśaviṣayakadarśanaṃ tva‍dabhinnaikārayakamiti vaiyākaraṇamate bodhaḥ| sa ca pramaiva|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ naśyat payaśyapaḥ iti itra ca atīta utpttika nāśa pratiyogika ghaṭa karmaka darśana āśrayaḥ tvaram iti nyāya mate bodhaḥ sa ca na saṃbhavati naṣṭa tvena na tad darśana asaṃbhavāt ghaṭa abhinna eka pratiyogika atīta utpayattika nāśa viṣayaka darśanam tvad abhinna eka ārayakam iti vaiyākaraṇa mate bodhaḥ sa ca pramā eva

original: tathā ca nyāghayamate tatra tatrāvyāpaptireveti bhāvaḥ| etena śṛṇu garjatītyāiderayogyotvā padanena| prathamārtha iti| tathā ca paśyi mṛgo dhāvatītya‍tra prathamāntāyarthamukhyaraviśeṣyaḥka bodhasvīkāre'pi nāmārthadhātvorthayorabhedātiriktasaṃbandhethanānvaśayabodho'vyugatpaganna iti niyamabhaṅgo nāsti|
analyzed: tathā ca tatra tatra avyāpaptiḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ etena śṛṇu garjati ityādeḥ ayogyā utvā padanena prathama arthaḥ iti tathā ca paśyi mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti atra bodha svīkāre api iti niyama bhaṅgaḥ na asti

original: dhāvanakartṛmṛganiṣṭhaprathamārthaviṣayatānirūpakapadarśanāśrayasvva mityāākārakānvāyabodhasvīokāreṇa karmatāsaṃbandhe na dhāvanakartṛmṛgasyatha darśanakriyāyāmananvyāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu kriyāmukhyāviśeṣyṛkānvyabodhasvīyakāre ‘prayāti puruṣasya caraṇāvabhivādaye' ityāedau tacchatabde na puruṣaparāmarśo na syākat|

original: prathamāntāerthasy puruṣasyāmakhyā tārthaviśeṣaṇatvesana mukhyāviśeṣya'tvāebhāvāddhaṭo'yaṃ tajjātirityāradeḥ prāmāṇyāmapattivāraṇāya tacchanabdsyara mukhyviśeṣyośapasthāpapakatvabhasvī kārādataḥ prathamāntājarthamukhyaraviśeṣyaḥkabodha eva svīdakartavya ityamata āha-kiṃ ceti|

original: evaṃ dhāvanakartṛmṛgakarmakadarśanāśrayasvymiti prathamāntā‍rthamukhyiviśeṣyavakabodhasvīākāre kutaḥ saṃkhyāṇanvāyastetra na syāmadityanata āha- ākhyāmatopasthāepyeutyāidi|

original: tatrāyamabhiprāyaḥ-tārkikamate kṛterākhyāātārthatayā kartṛranabhidhānāddevadattena pacatītyā diprayogāpattivāraṇāyākhyāvatārthabhāvanānvayayyanvathayisaṃkhyāyayāmanabhihitāyāmityayasyaḥ ‘kartṛkaraṇayostṛdatīyā' ityonabhihitādhikārīyasūtrārthatveāna svīākāreṇākhyā‍toktakartari karmaṇi ca taduktasaṃkhyākayā anvaraya iti vaktumaśakyaratvetana
analyzed: tatra ayam abhiprāyaḥ tārkika mate kṛteḥ ākhyāta artha tayā kartṛḥ anabhidhānāt devadattena pacati ityādi prayoga āpatti vāraṇāya kartṛ karaṇayoḥ ca tad ukta saṃkhyākayā anvaraye iti vaktum aśakya ratva itana

original: viśeṣyaratayākhyāyatopasthāīpysaṃkhyā prakārakānveyabodhaṃ prati prathamāntayapadajanyo‍pasthitiritaraviśeṣaṇatvayatātpataryāviṣayībhūtārthaniṣṭhaviśeṣytālakṣaṇamukhyviśeṣya tāsaṃbandhena heturiti svīmakaraṇīyam|

original: tathā ca paśyo mṛgo dhāvatītyātra mṛge itaraviśeṣaṇatvaratātpaṣaryaviṣayībhūtārthatve‍na niruktasaṃbandhesana tadupasthiterabhāvānmṛmage saṃkhyāsanvoyānupapattirdoṣa iti| nanu vaiyākaraṇamate'pi mṛgasyābhedasaṃbandheāna tiṅarthaviśeṣaṇatveṃna tadupasthātapya|saṃkhyāyanvayayaḥ kathamiti cenna| tanmagate tathā kāryakāraṇabhāvānaṅgīkārāt|

original: tanmate kīdṛśaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāva iti ceditthām "phalavyāāpārayordhāturāśraye tu tiṅaḥ smṛetāḥ| phale pradhānaṃ pradhānaṃ vyātapārastiṅarthastu viśeṣaṇam||" ityathatra phalaṃ viklittyā‍di vyālapārastuya bhāvanā'bhinnā sādhyakatavenābhidhīyamānā kriyā| dhātvadharthaṃ nirupya tiṅarthamāha-āśraye tviti| phalāśrayaṃ karma, vyāāpārāśrayaḥ kartā|
analyzed: tad mate kīdṛśaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ iti ced itthām phala vyāāpārayoḥ dhātuḥ āśraye tu tiṅaḥ phale pradhānam pradhānam phale pradhānam pradhānam vyātapāraḥ tiṅ arthaḥ tu viśeṣaṇam iti atha tra phalam bhāvanā bhinnā sādhyaka tavena abhidhīyamānā kriyā nirupya tiṅ artham āha āśraye tu iti phala āśrayam karma vyāāpāra āśrayaḥ kartā

original: tiṅarthāḥ kartṛkarmasaṃkhyākālāsttra kartā vyāpapāre viśeṣaṇaṃ, karma tu phale viśeṣaṇaṃ, saṃkhyāma kartṛpratyaṃye kartari, karmapratyapaye karmaṇi viśeṣaṇaṃ, kālastuā vyāvapāre viśeṣaṇaṃ na tu saṃkhyāphavatkertṛkarmaṇoḥ, atītabhāvanake kartari pacatītyāmapatteḥ, nāpi phale phalānutparattidaśāyāṃ vyāṇapārasattave pacatītyayanāpatteḥ|
analyzed: tiṅ arthāḥ kartṛ karma saṃkhyā kālāḥ ttra kartā vyāpa pāre viśeṣaṇam karma tu phale viśeṣaṇam kartṛ pratyaṃye kartari karma pratyapaye karmaṇi viśeṣaṇam kālaḥ tu ā viśeṣaṇam na tu atīta bhāvanake kartari pacati iti āma patteḥ na api phale phala anutparatti daśāyām pacati iti ayana āpatteḥ

original: tathā cākhyāḥtopasthāāpya saṃkhyākaprakārakabodhaṃ pratyāākhyātatajanyatakartṛkarmopasthitirheturiti kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ phalitaḥ| evaṃ ca caitrastaḥṇḍulaṃ pacatītyātra caitrābhinnaikakartṛkastṇḍutalabhūtakarmaniṣṭhaviklittyaṃnukūlavartamānakāliko vyā pāra iti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: tathā saṃkhyāka prakāraka bodham saṃkhyāka prakāraka bodham hetuḥ iti kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ phalitaḥ evam ca caitraḥ taṇḍulam pacati itya atra caitra abhinna eka kartṛkaḥ tṇḍu tala bhūta karma niṣṭha viklitti aṃnukūla vartamāna kālikaḥ vyā pāraḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: caitreṇa taṇḍutalaḥ pacayate ityavatra taṇḍuālābhinnaikakarmaniṣṭhaviklittyinukūlavartamānakālikacaitrakartṛko vyārapāra iti bodhaḥ| itthaṃai ca prakṛte ‘mṛgo dhāvati' itya tra mṛgābhinne kartari tadupasthiteḥ sattverana na tatra saṃkhyāānva yānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: caitreṇa taṇḍu talaḥ pacayate iti avatra ca prakṛte mṛgaḥ dhāvati tra mṛga abhinne kartari tad upasthiteḥ na tatra saṃkhyā anvaya anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu mukhyedhatyathaniveśyaka prathamāntavapadajanyoipasthiterhetutvesvīukārātra saṃkhyānva yānupapattirityayata āha-anyitheti| mukhyeviśeṣya‍tāsaṃbandhelana tādṛśopasthiterhetutvāyanaṅgīkāre iti tadarthaḥ| tathā ca tārkikamate tatra saṃkhyāmanvarayānupapattireva| saṃkhyādhananvye iṣṭāpattiṃ vārayati-mṛge ityāudi sādhutvārapatteritya|nteina|
analyzed: nanu saṃkhyā anvaya anupapattiḥ iti atas āha anyithā iti tādṛśa upasthiteḥ hetutve anaṅgīkāre iti tad arthaḥ tathā ca tārkika mate tatra saṃkhyām anvarayā anupapattiḥ eva iṣṭāpattim vārayati mṛge ityādi iṣṭāpattim vārayati mṛge

original: nanu ‘prayāti puruśastaisyava' ityayatra tacchatabdeāna puruṣaparāmarśo na syātaditi dūṣaṇaṃ tu vartata eveti cenna, taccha‍bda‍syu viśeṣaṇopasthāpapakatvatasyāāpi kutraciddṛṣṭatveyana viśeṣaṇībhūtasyāepi puruṣasya tacchakhabdeṣana parāmarśasaṃbhavādityā ha-kiṃ ceti|
analyzed: nanu prayāti puruśas taisyavaḥ puruṣa parāmarśaḥ na syātat iti dūṣaṇam tu vartate eva iti ced na kutracid dṛṣṭa tva iyana puruṣasya ca iti

original: nanu tarhi ghaṭo'yaṃ tajjātiritayādāvapi prāmāṇyaṃā syātattatrāpi tatpavadena ghaṭatvasaparāmarśasaṃbhavāditayata āha- paraṃ tviti| na parāmaśarma iti| padopasthitiprakārasyā tatpdena parāmarśāsaṃbhave'pi tadbhinnaviśeṣaṇasyana tatparadena parāmarśe bādhakābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ|

original: pārthasārathimiramate vidhyārthasyekaṣṭasādhanatva‍rūpatvāyat ‘yajeta' ityāādisthaṣale yāga iṣṭasādhanamityaṭanva‍yabādhesvīkāreṇa ‘dadhnā juhoti' ityasatra guṇavidhau dadhīṣṭasādhanamityatanvavayabodhaḥ, dhātvārthāṃśe'nuvādaḥ, homaniṣṭhaṃ dadhikaraṇakatva‍miṣṭasādhanamiti vānvadhayabodhaḥ|
analyzed: yajeta iti ādi stha ṣale yāgaḥ iṣṭa sādhanam iti a ṭ anvaya bādhe svīkāreṇa dadhnā juhoti iti a satra guṇa vidhau dadhi iṣṭa sādhanam iti a tanu avaya bodhaḥ dhātvārtha aṃśa inuvādaḥ homa niṣṭham dadhi karaṇaka tvam iṣṭa sādhanam iti

original: tathā ca prakṛte ‘soṣṇīdhaṣā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' ityadhatra pracaraṇāṅgabhūtāḥ soṣṇīmaṣā tratvija iṣṭasādhanamityayanva|yabodhasvītakāre uṣṇīṇaṣaviśiṣṭartvijāmiṣṭatasādhanatvāānvapaye uṣṇīṣasyāgapīṣṭasādhanatvāranvaṭayaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca prakṛte sa uṣṇīdhaṣāḥ ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti iti adhatra pracaraṇa aṅga bhūtāḥ uṣṇīṣa syāk api iṣṭa sādhana tvāranvapaye

original: evaṃ ‘lohitoṣṇībaṣā' ityītrāpi pracaraṇāṅgabhūtā lohitoṣṇīṣaviśiṣṭartvija iṣṭasādhanamitynvauyabodhasvīākāre lauhityiviśiṣṭoṣṇī ṣasy ṛtvigdvā reṣṭasādhanatānvavaye lauhitysyānapīṣṭasādhanatvāṇanvasaya ityāṅgīkāraḥ|
analyzed: evam pracaraṇa aṅga bhūtāḥ lohita uṣṇīṣa viśiṣṭa ṛtvijaḥ iṣṭa sādhanam iti nvauya bodha svīākāre lauhityi viśiṣṭa uṣṇī ṣasi iti āṅgīkāraḥ

original: tathā ca prakṛte'pi dhāvanakriyāviśiṣṭamṛgasyaṇa dṛśikriyākarmatve dhavanasyāāpi dṛśikriyākarmatvaṃi bhāṣya‍saṃmatamakṣatameveti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca prakṛte api dhāvana kriyā viśiṣṭa mṛga syaṇa dṛśi kriyā karma tve bhāṣya saṃmatam akṣatam eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: bhaṭṭamate'pi ‘somena yajeta' ityaṭatra somavatā yogeneṣṭaṃ bhāvayediti vākyādharthasvīākāre somaviśiṣṭayāgasyabha bhāvanāyāṃ karaṇatvetanānvīye yāgadvārā somasyāipi karaṇatve‍nānva ye bādhakābhāvena viśeṣyāranvadayyanviyitvrūpaṃ viśeṣaṇatvmeṣāmapīṣṭamevetyu dāhṛtasthle dvayorapi soṣṇīāṣaiḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ pracaraṇaṃ bhāvayellohitoṣṇīāṣairṛtvigbhiḥ
analyzed: bhaṭṭa mate pi somena yajeta iti somavatā yogena iṣṭam bhāvayet iti bhāvanāyām yāga dvārā bhāvanāyām bādhaka abhāvena dvayoḥ api sa uṣṇīāṣaiḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ pracaraṇam bhāvayet lohita uṣṇīāṣaiḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ

original: pracaraṇaṃ bhāvayedityavanvavayabodhasvīkāreṇa viśeṣaṇībhūtoṣṇīṭaṣasyapa ṛtvigdvārā lohitasyava coṣṇīpaṣadvārā bhāvanākaraṇatvaisyeṣṭatveṇana viśeṣyāyanvayayyanvatayitvīrūpaviśeṣaṇatvayamavyānahatamiti| dhāvanasyāpi mṛgadvārā dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmatāsaṃbandheṣanānvaṇayitvaṛmavyāvahatamiti na virodhaḥ|
analyzed: pracaraṇam bhāvayet iti ṛtvij dvārā ṛtvij dvārā ca uṣṇī paṣa dvārā iti dhāvanasya api mṛga dvārā dṛśi kriyāyām na virodhaḥ

original: na ca bhaṭṭamate somena yajetetyādau yāgasyaiāva karaṇatavaṃ na tu somasyākapi, anya‍thā yāgasyara somavattvaṃya somena yajeteti vākyāentaṭaraṃ vinā nopapadyata ityrthākṣiptavākyemana ‘somena yāgaṃ bhāvayet' ityayanvayayabodhasvīyakāro'nupapannaḥ syā diti vācyayam|
analyzed: na ca bhaṭṭa mate somena yajeta ityādau karaṇa tavam na tu anyathā somena yajeta iti vākya ainta ṭaram vinā na upapadyate iti ṛtha ākṣipta somena yāgam bhāvayet syāt iti syāt iti

original: ‘vidhāne vānuvāde vā yāgaḥ karaṇamiṣya‍te' iti vārtikena ‘dadhnā juhoti' ityā disthile'pi kevalaguṇavidhau dadhimatā homeneṣṭaṃ bhāvayediti vākyāvarthabodhasya|
analyzed: vidhāne vā anuvāde vā yāgaḥ karaṇam iṣyate iti vārtikena dadhnā juhoti kevala guṇa vidhau dadhimatā homena iṣṭam bhāvayet iti vākyau artha bodhasya

original: svīikārastithā cātrāpi dadhimattvaṃe home dadhnā juhotī‍ti vākyāāntayaramantalareṇa dhātvaharthasyaiṭava karaṇatvevana dadhyādikaraṇabhāvanāyā ālābhena śrūyamāṇaguṇavidhyatanupapattiriti viśiṣṭasyava yāgasyaha bhāvanāyāṃ karaṇatvethanānva'ye viśeṣaṇasyāhapi karaṇatve‍nānvavaya ityeṅgīkārasyai‍va yuktatvā dvākayāntayarakalparane gauravācceti
analyzed: ca atra api home dadhnā juhoti iti gauravāt ca iti

original: viśeṣyānanvayayyanvoyitvavarūpaṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ‍ mīmāṃsāyāṃ spavaṣṭamityagabhipretyaṇa viśeṣyā‍nvyyanva yitvaṣarūpaṃ viśeṣaṇatvayamāha-tathā hītyāśadi svīākārādityontevana| tatrāpi uttaravākyeva'pi, paraṃparayā svāṣaśrayāśrayatvakasaṃbandhe‍na, anvatayaścāsyana uṣṇīṣadvārā ṛtvigrūpaviśaṣya te|
analyzed: viśeṣya ananvaya yi anvoyi tva va rūpam viśeṣaṇa tvam mīmāṃsāyām tathā hi ityāśadi tatra api uṣṇīṣa dvārā uṣṇīṣa dvārā teṣām

original: tathā ca lauhityavasya svāvaśrayāśrayatvasasaṃbandherana svāviśeṣyḥ ṛtivakpatadārthastanadanvayayineṣṭasādhanatvedanānvūya iti phalitam| nanu dhāvanāśrayamṛgasyaya dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmatve‍nān‍vaye "paśyasa mṛgo dhāvati' iti na brūyāddhāvantaṃha mṛgaṃ paśyeātyeyava brūyādityāyaśayenākṣipati-yāttviti|
analyzed: tathā ca sva avaśraya āśraya tva sa saṃbandheḥ iti phalitam nanu dṛśi kriyāyām karmatvena anvaye mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti na brūyāt dhāvantam ha mṛgam brūyāt iti āyaśayena ākṣipati yāt tu iti

original: nīlaṃ ghaṭaṃ paśy nīlaghaṭaṃ paśyeti vyāosasamāsayoḥ prayoge vaktṛhatātpa ryasyaiyava niyāmakatāyā dṛṣṭatvāyatpiścaya mṛgo dhāvati dhāvantaṃ‍ mṛgaṃ paśyeāti prayogadvaividh‍ye'pi vākayārthabhedasya‍ niyāmakatvāpabhāvena vakturicchādayā eva niyāmakatvimityāśayena samādhatte-tanna payārayetyāedinā|
analyzed: nīlam ghaṭam paśi nīla ghaṭam paśya iti mṛgaḥ dhāvati dhāvantam mṛgam paśya iti prayoga dvaividhye pi vaktuḥ icchā ādayaḥ eva samādhatte tat na

original: sati vaktustātpa rye dhāvantaṃṛ mṛgaṃ paśyetyakatrāpi prayoge iṣṭāpatternaitāvatā paśyava mṛgo dhāvatītyayasyana hānirnahyabhedārthakaparyāyāṇāṃ madhyeva prakaprayoge satyparaḥ prayogakaḥ kenacinniṣeddhuṃ śakyaita iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: sati vaktuḥ tātpa rye mṛgam paśya iti akatra api prayoge iṣṭa āpatteḥ na etāvatā hāniḥ na hi abheda arthaka paryāyāṇām madhyā iva sati paraḥ prayogakaḥ kenacid niṣeddhum śakyā ete iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu dhāvantaṃā mṛgaṃ paśyana, paśyā mṛgo dhāvatītya nayorekanna mṛgānvitakarmatvamasyā paratra karmatvanasaṃbandhe‍na mṛgasyama darśanakriyāyāmanvayayavivakṣetyayarthabhedo'syeye veti dhāvanakriyāyāḥ karmatve‍na dṛśikriyāyāmanvakayavivakṣāyāṃ paśyata mṛgo dhāvatītye‍va prayogaḥ kartavyaya ityta āha- sarvatheti| na kāpayanupapattiriti|
analyzed: nanu mṛgam mṛgaḥ mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti mṛga anvita karmatvam asyāḥ paratra vā iti dhāvana kriyāyāḥ karmatvena dṛśi kriyāyām anvaka yavivakṣāyām paśyata mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti eva prayogaḥ kartavyayaḥ iti te āha sarvathā iti na iti

original: dhāvanakriyāviśiṣṭamṛgasyara karmatve‍nānvīye bhāṣykārādivivakṣāvirodho dhāvatītya tra śatrāpattirmṛgapadottaraṃ dvitīyāpattiritye|vamādyanupapattiḥ kāpi nāstīvati bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: dhāvana kriyā viśiṣṭa mṛgasya ra karma tvena anvīye bhāṣykāra ādi vivakṣā virodhaḥ dhāvati iti a tra āpattiḥ mṛga pada uttaram dvitīya āpattiḥ iti evamādi anupapattiḥ kā api na asti iva iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanveīkatiṅantāvarthamukhyaṣaviśeṣyākabodhajanakapadasamudāyatvaṃ‍ vākytvmityatatra tāsrikaisitaṅantanasamūhaḥ subantīsamūha ityāīdikrameṇa vākyaṃā tridhā vibhajyā trayaḥ kālā ityā dikrameṇodāhṛty trayaḥ kālā itayatra tiṅantamapadābhāvenāvyāīptābhihitāyāṃ jñāyanta‍ iti padādhyākhahāreṇa tritvavaviśiṣṭābhinnakālābhinnāśrayavṛtti (?viṣayaka)
analyzed: tridhā vibhajyā trayaḥ kālāḥ iti ādi krameṇa jñāyante iti pada adhyākhahāreṇa tri tva va viśiṣṭa abhinna kāla abhinna āśraya vṛtti viṣayaka

original: jñānamityinvatayabodhasvīpakāreṇa vaiyākaraṇoktavākyatalakṣaṇasyaya nirduṣṭatvāvat ‘paśy mṛgo dhāvati' ityavatrāpi kriyāyāḥ karmatayā dṛśikriyāyāmanvavaye'pi bādhakābhāva ityāśaṅkya samādhātumanuvadati- yattviti| ‘trayaḥ kālā jñāyante' itytra tvataduktalakṣaṇasyāāvyā ptya bhāve'pi kati kālā iti praśne trayaḥ kālā ityuittaraṃ dṛśyavate|
analyzed: nirduṣṭa tva avat paśi mṛgaḥ dhāvati bādhaka abhāvaḥ iti āśaṅkya samādhātum anuvadati yat tu iti trayaḥ kālāḥ jñāyante iti tra kati kālāḥ iti praśne trayaḥ kālāḥ iti u ttaram kati kālāḥ iti praśne trayaḥ kālāḥ iti u ttaram dṛśyavate

original: tatra kriyādhyāḥhāre prayojakanābhāvāllakṣaṇamavyākaptamityāraśayenāha-tanneti| kriyāvinirmuktatvayasaṃbhavāditi| na ca kati kālāsrayaḥ kālā iti praśnottaravākayayorapi bhavanti jñāyant iti padādhyāihārasaṃbhavānnoktalakṣaṇamavyā ptāmiti vācyaḥm|
analyzed: tatra kriyā adhyāḥhāre prayojaka nābhāvāt lakṣaṇam avyākaptam iti āraśayeṇa āha tat na iti kriyā vinirmukta tvayā asaṃbhavāt iti na ca kati kāla asrayaḥ kālāḥ iti praśna uttaravākayayoḥ api bhavanti iti pada adhyāhāra saṃbhavāt na ukta lakṣaṇam avyāptām iti

original: kati kālā iti kālatvvyābhapyanaprakāraviśeṣajijñāsayā praśnakaraṇe tajjijñāsānivartanāya prakāraviśeṣajñānakottaravākyatasyai vākā‍ṅkṣitatvevanānākāṅkṣitakriyādhyāpahārasyānucitatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kati kālāḥ iti praśna karaṇe tad jijñāsā nivartanāya

original: nanu kriyāmukhyviśeṣyajakānvyabodhamaṅgīkṛtyaśa prathamāntāṣarthamukhyakaviśeṣyākabodhasvīikāre ‘śṛṇu garjati meghaḥ' ‘naṭo gāyati śṛṇu' ‘ghaṭo'naśyajatpśyadha' ityāthadau garjanāśrayameghasy gānakartṛnaṭasyo śrāvaṇakarmatvā‘saṃbhavāt , vartamānanāśapratiyogyaṭamutpottikanāśapratiyogighaṭasyaśa dṛśyārthakarmatvāyasaṃbhavācca
analyzed: nanu garjana āśraya meghasya gāna kartṛ naṭasya śrāvaṇa karma tva asaṃbhavāt vartamāna nāśa pratiyogi aṭamutpottika nāśa pratiyogi ghaṭasya śa dṛśya artha karma tva ayasaṃbhavāt ca

original: kriyāmukhyajaviśeṣyatakānvasayabodha eva svīmakartavyo itīmāṃ śaṅkā samādhātumanuvadati-yattu śṛṇviti| ‘saviśeṣṇera hi vidhiniṣadho pravartamānau' iti nyātayena garjanasyaba gānasyana nāśasyaya ca śrudṛśyārthānviyasaṃbhavena na kāpya‘nupapattirityāhaha-tanna, saviśeṣaṇe hītyāādinā|
analyzed: eva iti imām śaṅkā samādhātum anuvadati yat tu śṛṇu iti hi pravartamānau iti na kā api anupapattiḥ iti āha ha tat na sa viśeṣaṇe hi ityādinā

original: na ca saviśeṣaṇe hīti nyāyamāśritya‍ sādhānaṃ na saṃbhavati tādṛśanyāoye pramāṇābhāvāditi vācyim| svrgī dhvsta,ḥ, śikhī dhvanasteḥ, śikhī dhvayasta ḥ, ityāyadi prayogadarśanāddhastā ityatatra kta pratyarayārthadhvaṃisapratiyoginaḥ śikhinaḥ svrgiṇaścāvināśena tatrānvyāsaṃbhavena śikhāsvanargayostdanvāyasvītakārāt|
analyzed: na ca sa viśeṣaṇe hi iti nyāyam āśritya sādhānam na saṃbhavati tādṛśa pramāṇa abhāvāt iti svrgī śikhī śikhī śikhī iti āyadi prayoga darśanāt hastāḥ pratyaraya artha dhvaṃi sa pratiyoginaḥ śikhinaḥ ca avināśena tatra anvya saṃbhavena

original: na ca dhvaṃṇasapratiyoginaḥ prathamāntārthasyaḥ śikhāyāṃ svararge cāpadārthe prati padajanyavapadārthopasthitirmukhyanaviśeṣyavatāsaṃbandhenana kāraṇamityetatādṛśārthaka- ‘padārthaḥ padārthenānveti na tu padārthaikadeśena' iti nyāyāditi vācyim| ekadeśānvyasyāāpi kvacidṛṣṭatvāt|
analyzed: na ca śikhāyām svararge ca apadārthe prati pada janya va padārtha upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti eta tādṛśa arthaka padārthaḥ padārthena anveti na tu padārtha ekadeśena iti nyāyāt iti eka deśa anvyasya api kvacid dṛṣṭa tvāt

original: nanu k dūṣṭamiticet- śaraiḥ śātitapatraścaitrasyā gurukulamityāedau darśanāt| nanu ghaṭo nityacaḥ paśurapaśurityāādāvapi nitytvāāśrayaghaṭatvivān, paśubhinnapaśutvatavānitayādyanvayayabodhe bādhakābhāvena teṣāmapi prāmāṇyaṃna syākhaditi cenna|
analyzed: nanu dūṣṭam iti ced śaraiḥ śātita patraḥ caitrasya guru kulam ityādau darśanāt nanu ghaṭaḥ paśuḥ a paśuḥ ityādau api bādhaka abhāvena teṣām api prāmāṇyam na ced na

original: śarairisyāsadeḥ sākāṅkṣatvā dekadeśānva‍yasaṃbhave'pi ghaṭo nityapa ityānadernityavasākākṣaṅkṣa- tvāmabhāvenāprāmāṇyāāt| nanu sva rgī dhvāstaya ityāvadau nityesākāṅkṣatvāebhāvātkaśathamekadeśānvayaya iti cenna| anvyabodhasyasa tātpaparyādhīnatvemana prakṛte ekadeśānvarayatātperyasyā, prāmāṇyāānyāthānupapattyāva svīvakārāt|
analyzed: śaraiḥ ityādeḥ sākāṅkṣa tvāt eka deśa anvaya saṃbhave pi ghaṭaḥ ityādeḥ aprāmāṇyāt nanu prakṛte prakṛte

original: na ca ghaṭo nitaya ityāṣaderapi tātpaparyasadbhāve ekadeśānveyasaṃbhave prāmāṇyāpattiriti vācym| sati tātpirye iṣṭatvānat| ata eva hi yatra padārthe'nvasayāsaṃbhavastanatra bhāvapradhānanideraśaparatayāpi nirvāho grantha‍kṛtāṃ saṃgacchte, sarvato balavatī hyanya thānupapattiriti nyāyāt|
analyzed: na ca ghaṭaḥ nitaye iti āṣadeḥ api eka deśa anveya saṃbhave prāmāṇya āpattiḥ iti vācyam sati tātpirye atas eva hi yatra nirvāhaḥ granthakṛtām saṃgacchate sarvatas balavatī hi nyāyāt

original: na ca śikhī dhvsta ityāradau śikhyāhadipadasyama śikhāmātralākhaṇikatveṭana śikhā dhvaṃsapratiyogyibhinnetynvatayabodhasvīśakāre ‘śikhā dhvakhastāta' ‘svīrgo dhvathast' ityāyadivācakaśabdaraprayogasyaiva ‘svā‍yatte śabdprayoga kimitya vācakaṃ prayuñjmahe' iti nyā‍yena saṃbhava iti vācyapam| lākṣaṇikamātrasyaiva vilayaprasaṅavilayaprasgāt|
analyzed: na ca śikhī iti āradau śikhā mātra lākhaṇika tva śikhā śikhā svaṃsa pratiyogyi bhinnā iti nva taya bodha śakāre śikhā svīrgaḥ dhvathaḥ iti āyadi vācaka śabda ra prayogasya eva sva āyatte vācakam prayuñjmahe iti nyāyena saṃbhavaḥ iti lākṣaṇika mātrasya eva vilaya prasaṅga vilaya prasgāt

original: na ca lākṣaṇikaṃ dvividhaṃ nirūḍhaṃ prayojanavacca| nirūḍhaṃ kuśalādi| prayojanavadgaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityāvadi| tatra ‘svatargī dhvistayaḥ' ityāsadikaṃ na prayojanavat, prayojanasyaṃ śaityarapāvanatvāodipratīterivātra prayojanapratīterabhāvāt nāpi nirūḍhamanāditātpa ryakalpnāgauravāpatteriti vācyavam|
